entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that performs system information acquisition and cell barring procedures.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle state where UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control inactive state where UE maintains some connection context.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: Radio Resource Control connected state where UE has an active connection.

entities.name: Timer T311
entities.description: Timer running during connection establishment or recovery procedures.

entities.name: Master Information Block
entities.description: Essential system information block containing basic cell parameters.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: Essential system information block containing cell access parameters and scheduling information.

entities.name: Cell barring procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE considers a cell as barred and performs appropriate actions.

entities.name: RedCap UE
entities.description: Reduced Capability User Equipment with specific barring procedures.

entities.name: Cell re-selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE selects and moves to another cell on the same frequency.

relations.description: Cell barring procedure is performed when UE is in RRC_IDLE state.
Cell barring procedure is performed when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Cell barring procedure is performed when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state while T311 is running.
Cell barring procedure requires T311 timer to be running in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Cell barring is triggered when UE is unable to acquire MIB.
Cell barring is triggered when UE is unable to acquire SIB1.
Specific barring procedure applies when UE is a RedCap UE unable to acquire SIB1.
Cell barring procedure includes cell re-selection to other cells on the same frequency.
